purpose: Bounded cached-feature replay, not fresh LLM parsing, preview analysis, or held-out musical quality.

environment.metadata: Installed Discogs SQLite with provider fallback enabled; isolated SQLite-backup copies of existing caches.

limitations: Only completed rows contribute to pass and latency denominators; interrupted rows and unattempted cases are separate.
Exact raw parsed intents reused; no fresh parse/fallback/truncation measurement and no replacement-anchor LLM.
Cached-audio-only prevents new preview retrieval; absent/incompatible cached features remain unknown.
Enhanced modes and engine-only overlapped each other and repository checks; these are workload observations, not controlled speed comparisons.
No held-out listening labels or independently reviewed per-track genre judgments; count and reported fulfillment are not musical correctness.
Full reports remain temporary; compact records retain public fixture prompts, selected catalog IDs and snapshots only.
